documents.text: Terry McDonald (footballer) Terry McDonald (born 12 November 1938) is an English former footballer who played mostly as a Winger, mainly for Leyton Orient. McDonald was born in Stepney, London. As a youngster, he was on the books of West Ham United, but only made one appearance in their first team, in a friendly against Spartak Prague in October 1958. As a member of West Ham's youth team, he played in the defeat to Manchester United, and had also played for England Youth against Hungary in Budapest in 1956.
